name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>; accurately describes the worker (earthquake spell with full-screen shake). No Ghidra address residue; no domain ID involved in the name.
purpose: Earthquake (地震) spell cinematic worker for battle: full-screen shake + scaled tile-map redraw + SFX burst, then applies per-target magic damage.
logic_summary: Saves battle_scene_snapshot and rebuilds it via fd2_convert_battle_tiles_to_24px(); zeroes the AoE/fx-queue counter; deducts caster MP. Allocates 4 work buffers (64000 + 0x25680 + 0x25680 + 0x4000); any malloc failure -> printf('Out of memory at Earth Quack !!') + exit(0). Builds tile_table[map_h x 0x40] of (snapshot + attr*0x240 + 6) addresses. Slow shake: 3 large-displacement frames blitting the scaled tile-map view (X = max_x*0x600 + origin_x*0xC00 + shake_x[i], Y similarly, scale = shake_params[i+6]) then repainting non-dead party sprites. Fast tremor: 60 frames, fd2_play_sfx_with_handle(SFX 0xD) every 6th frame up to frame 0x2B, blit + fd2_delay_ms(10) each frame. Cleanup: free 3 buffers (the 0x4000 tile_table is intentionally never freed -- original leak preserved), restore large_game_state_buffer + battle_scene_snapshot, composite frame. Per target: damage = fd2_calc_magic_damage(target_id, spell_id); damage==0 -> show miss indicator, else show_damage_number(damage, '^', target_id). Finale: composite frame + fd2_animate_spell_projectile_paths().
signature: void __cdecl fd2_cast_earthquake_spell_with_screen_shake(uint32 caster_unit_id, uint32 spell_id, uint32 num_targets, uint8 *target_id_array)

params.name: caster_unit_id
params.semantics: Caster unit index (into runtime_char_array). Passed straight to fd2_deduct_caster_mp. Confirmed by caller fd2_cast_spell_0a_basic pushing the caster arg first.

params.name: spell_id
params.semantics: Spell id literal injected by the dispatcher (0xA/0xB/0xC via shared tail). Used by fd2_deduct_caster_mp and fd2_calc_magic_damage.

params.name: num_targets
params.semantics: Number of target ids; upper bound of the per-target damage loop.

params.name: target_id_array
params.semantics: Pointer to an array of target unit ids; each byte is dereferenced as the target for damage/miss/damage-number display.
params.reason: Accurate, descriptive, no address residue (replaces the old misleading 'p_targets/4th var' Ghidra naming).

returns.semantics: No return value. Normal path ends with explicit RET at 0x2185E; out-of-memory path calls exit(0) (does not return).

comment_original_issue: src comment block was already accurate, precise, and ASCII (algorithm, shake-params table layout, buf_table mirroring, original leak/free behavior, injected __CHK(0x6c) prologue). No change needed.
notes: Ghidra plate had two stale references that now contradicted the live decompile: (1) the params note still said 'param_1=caster ... caster_unit_id=p_targets (4th var misleading)' though the params are already named caster_unit_id/spell_id/num_targets/target_id_array; (2) the fast-tremor delay call was written as __delay_thunk_375b2(10) but the live decompile shows fd2_delay_ms(10). Updated the plate to current names; rest left verbatim. src comment left unchanged (already correct), so only the shard is staged for commit.
